*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]

***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] blow up a bridge located between [[Bakhmut]] and [[Kostiantynivka]] as [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]] and [[Wagner Group]] fighters advance on the city. **[[Iranian involvement in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[United States Central Command]] says [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] have shot down an [[Iran]]ian [[Unmanned surveillance and reconnaissance aerial vehicle|UAV]] near a patrol base and [[Petroleum reservoir|oil field]] in [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/us-military-shoots-down-suspected-iranian-made-drone-over-syrian-oil-site-1781296 (Newsweek)]

**Three [[Pakistani Taliban]] members are killed by fellow militants who were trying to free them while being transported from [[Miranshah]] to [[Bannu]], [[Pakistan]] by counter-terrorism officers. '''International relations'''

**[[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
***[[Philippine president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] summons [[List of ambassadors of China to the Philippines|Chinese ambassador]] [[Huang Xilian]] following a [[China Coast Guard]] vessel's alleged use of a [[laser weapon]] on a [[Philippine]] ship in the [[South China Sea]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Phase-out of fossil fuel vehicles]]
**The [[European Parliament]] formally approves a law to ban the sale of new petrol and diesel [[vehicle]]s in the [[European Union]] from 2035, citing the need to combat [[climate change in Europe]] and promote [[electric vehicle]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/eu-lawmakers-approve-effective-2035-ban-new-fossil-fuel-cars-2023-02-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sri Lanka]] announces a ban on [[Disposable product|disposable]] cutlery, [[Cocktail shaker|cocktail shaker]]s, and [[artificial plants]] beginning in June, citing the risk of [[plastic pollution]] on [[Wildlife of Sri Lanka|its wildlife]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230214-sri-lanka-bans-single-use-plastics-to-save-elephants (AFP via RFI)]
